_about: Gatehouse (the launcher) has its own version and its own notes, apart from any pack's. tools/build_popup.ps1 puts this file inside the launcher, which shows it under Gatehouse updates on its main window; Gatekeeper shows it too. Newest first.

notes: Gatehouse now has its own version and its own notes, here. Until now its changes were listed with each pack's, so a server's Client updates tab was mostly about the launcher. From now on that tab is only about the pack; changes to Gatehouse are on this tab, and changes to Gatekeeper are on a Gatekeeper updates tab beside a Gatekeeper's servers.

Gatehouse updates itself when you open it directly, with no server lined up: it checks where your packs get their updates, fetches a newer launcher if there is one, and reopens. This tab comes to the front when that has happened.

Everything before this is in the pack's own notes (CHANGELOG.md in the repository), up to pack 1.16.0: the three-level menu, Add Gatekeeper, Install, plain servers, the Steam config buttons, controller navigation and the rest.
